06 — Questions

Good to know.

Can't find what you're looking for? Write to us at hello@naturalbloom.ca and our team will be in touch.

Who can book with Bloom?

Bloom is a virtual clinic for adults who are physically located in Alberta at the time of their visit. Children and teens under 18 can also be seen. See below.

Can my child be seen at Bloom?

Yes. Children and teens under 18 can be registered by a parent or legal guardian, as long as at least one parent is an active Bloom client. This helps us care for your family as one connected household.

Is Bloom covered by Alberta Health Care?

No. Bloom is a private service and visits are not billed to Alberta Health Care. Some extended health plans may cover Nurse Practitioner visits. Check with your provider. You'll receive a receipt for every visit.

Can the Nurse Practitioner order lab work and prescriptions?

Yes, within their scope and only when clinically appropriate following an assessment. Requisitions are provided for lab work at a local collection site, and prescriptions can be sent to the pharmacy of your choice. Results appear in your portal once your care team has reviewed them.

What is Daisy?

Daisy is an automated AI assistant in your client portal, available 24/7. Daisy shares general, non-medical wellness information and helps you find your way around the portal. Daisy can't give medical advice or review your results, and is not a substitute for your care team.

Is Bloom for urgent care?

No. Bloom does not provide urgent or emergency care. If you have an emergency, call 911. For non-urgent health advice, call Health Link at 811.

Website disclaimer

The information on this website, including Library and Discover articles, is general information only. It is not medical advice and does not replace an assessment by a qualified health professional. Reading this website or contacting us does not create a practitioner–client relationship.

In an emergency, call 911 or go to your nearest emergency department. For non-urgent health advice, call Health Link at 811. Bloom does not provide urgent or emergency care.

Virtual care

Bloom provides virtual care to patients who are physically located in Alberta at the time of their visit. Each practitioner works within their professional scope and standards. Tests, prescriptions and recommendations are provided only when clinically appropriate following an assessment. If virtual care isn't the right fit for your needs, we will let you know and help you find appropriate care.

Our Herbalist & Nutrition Specialist provides non-medical education and coaching that complements, and does not replace, medical care.

Daisy, our AI assistant

Daisy is an automated AI assistant available in the client portal. Daisy shares general, non-medical wellness information and helps you find your way around the portal. Daisy cannot give medical advice, review your results or replace your care team.

Privacy

We protect your personal and health information in accordance with Alberta's health privacy laws. Our full Privacy Policy explains what we collect, why we collect it, the legal authority for collecting it, how it is stored and who you can contact with questions.

Read our full Privacy Policy

Fees & cancellations

Bloom is a private clinic. Visits are not billed to Alberta Health Care, and we do not direct bill insurance. You will receive a receipt for every visit. You may cancel or reschedule online up to 24 hours before your appointment. Within 24 hours of your appointment, please call the clinic to cancel. Cancellations within 24 hours are charged the full visit fee.

Third-party links

This website may link to services operated by others, such as our online booking platform. We are not responsible for the content or privacy practices of those websites.

Who we are

Bloom is a virtual integrative care clinic operated by [Legal entity name], based in Calgary, Alberta. We provide care to patients who are physically located in Alberta at the time of their visit.

Our Nurse Practitioners are custodians of health information under Alberta's Health Information Act (HIA). Personal information that is not health information, and information handled in connection with non-medical wellness services, is protected under Alberta's Personal Information Protection Act (PIPA). We follow whichever law applies.

Information we collect

We only collect what we need to provide and manage your care:

  • Identity & contact details: name, date of birth, email, phone, address and Alberta Health Care number.
  • Health information: health history, symptoms, goals, visit notes, care plans, lab requisitions and results, and prescriptions.
  • Booking & payment details: appointments, receipts and payment records. Card details are processed by our secure payment provider and are not stored by Bloom.
  • Communications: messages and emails you send us.
  • Website information: basic technical information such as browser type and pages visited.

Why we collect it

  • To assess, plan and provide your care, and to coordinate care between your practitioners.
  • To book appointments, send reminders and manage your client portal.
  • To process payments and issue receipts.
  • To meet our professional, regulatory and legal obligations.
  • To maintain and improve the quality and safety of our services.

Legal authority & consent

We collect, use and disclose health information as permitted by the Health Information Act [specific section(s) to be confirmed by legal counsel], and personal information as permitted by the Personal Information Protection Act. Where consent is required, we will ask for it, and you may withdraw your consent at any time, subject to legal or contractual limits. Withdrawing consent may affect our ability to provide some services.

How we use & share it

Your information is accessed only by those who need it to care for you or run the clinic. We may share it:

  • Between your Bloom practitioners, to coordinate your care.
  • With laboratories, pharmacies and other health providers involved in your care, including referrals.
  • With service providers that help us operate, such as our booking and records platform, video visit, email and payment providers, under agreements that require them to protect it.
  • When required or permitted by law, such as to a regulatory college or court order.

We never sell your information.

Technology, AI & automated systems

Your information is entered into secure electronic systems, including our practice management platform [Jane] and our client portal. Daisy, our automated AI assistant in the portal, shares general, non-medical wellness information and portal support. Daisy does not give medical advice or interpret your results.

[Confirm: privacy impact assessment(s) submitted to the Office of the Information and Privacy Commissioner of Alberta for these systems.]

Storage & security

We protect your information with administrative, technical and physical safeguards, including encrypted connections (SSL), role-based access, secure passwords and staff confidentiality agreements. [Confirm where records are stored, e.g. on servers located in Canada.]

Retention

We keep health records for the period required by law and professional standards [retention period to be confirmed], and then securely destroy them.

Your rights

  • Access: you may request a copy of your health and personal information.
  • Correction: you may ask us to correct information you believe is inaccurate or incomplete.
  • Consent: you may withdraw consent where consent is the basis for collection.

To make a request, contact our Privacy Officer. We will respond within the time required by law.

Children & families

Children and teens under 18 can be registered by a parent or legal guardian who is an active Bloom client. A parent or guardian provides information and consent on the child's behalf, as permitted by law.

Communications

We use email and text to send appointment reminders and care-related messages. We will only send newsletters or promotional messages with your consent, and you can unsubscribe at any time.

Website & cookies

Our website may use essential cookies and basic analytics to function and improve. Please do not send health information through general email or website forms; use your secure client portal instead.

If something goes wrong

If a privacy breach occurs that creates a risk of harm, we will notify affected individuals and the appropriate authorities as required by law.
